# Overview

[Open Babel](https://openbabel.org) is a C++ library for reading, writing
and converting chemical file formats, computing descriptors and
fingerprints, and more. `Ropenbabel` bundles the Open Babel sources and
builds them as a static library when the package is installed, so that
other R packages can link to Open Babel on Linux, macOS and Windows without
a system installation. It follows the model of `Rhtslib` and `Rhdf5lib`.

`Ropenbabel` itself has no user-level functionality. End users will
normally use a client package such as `ChemmineOB`.

```{r}
library(Ropenbabel)
obVersion()
```

# Using Ropenbabel from another package

In the client package's `DESCRIPTION`:

```
Imports: Ropenbabel
LinkingTo: Ropenbabel
SystemRequirements: GNU make
```

In `src/Makevars` (and `src/Makevars.win`, using `Rscript.exe`):

```
RSCRIPT = "$(R_HOME)/bin/Rscript"
PKG_CPPFLAGS = $(shell $(RSCRIPT) -e "Ropenbabel::pkgconfig('PKG_CPPFLAGS')")
PKG_LIBS     = $(shell $(RSCRIPT) -e "Ropenbabel::pkgconfig('PKG_LIBS')")
```

`pkgconfig()` gives the include path and the libraries to link:

```{r}
pkgconfig("PKG_CPPFLAGS")
pkgconfig("PKG_LIBS")
```

Then include Open Babel headers as usual, e.g.
`#include <openbabel/mol.h>`. Because the library is static, all file
formats and plugins are registered at link time; no plugin directory is
needed at run time.

# Data files

Open Babel reads force-field parameters, atom typing rules and similar
data from the directory given by the `BABEL_DATADIR` environment
variable. `Ropenbabel` sets it to `dataDir()` when it is loaded, unless it
is already set. A client package that imports `Ropenbabel` gets this
automatically.

```{r}
dataDir()
```

# Build options

* Cairo, if found with `pkg-config` at install time, enables PNG output
    (Open Babel's `png` format). Set the environment variable
    `OB_DISABLE_CAIRO=ON` to build without it.
* `OB_JOBS` sets the number of parallel compile jobs (default 2).
* Formats that need network downloads at build time (Maestro, JSON) and
    optional libraries (libxml2, Boost, wxWidgets) are disabled.

# Session info

```{r}
sessionInfo()
```
